examples.original: [clean] Search for the object in likely locations such as countertops, drawers, cabinets, or near sinks/basins.
examples.control: [clean] Keep a bare ring about a stride wide so grass does not compete for moisture.

examples.original: [clean] Clean the object using a sinkbasin or similar cleaning location.
examples.control: [clean] Collect seed heads in labelled envelopes once the capsules rattle.

examples.original: [clean] Always verify the object is clean before placing it in the target location.
examples.control: [clean] Sharpen the pruning shears each spring so every cut heals smoothly and evenly.

examples.original: [clean] Open containers (drawers, cabinets) before attempting to place or retrieve items.
examples.control: [clean] If seedlings stretch on a bright ledge, sow the next batch.
